headline: Quirino Governor Dax Cua Dies at 48
seoTitle: Quirino Governor Dax Cua Dies at 48 | FMB News
seoDescription: Quirino Governor Dakila Carlo 'Dax' Cua has died at 48, the House of Representatives confirmed. His cause of death has not been publicly disclosed.
deck: The House of Representatives confirmed the death of Quirino Governor Dakila Carlo 'Dax' Cua. Independent reports place his death on September 15. His family and provincial government have not publicly disclosed the cause.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Quirino Governor Dakila Carlo 'Dax' Cua has died at the age of 48, the House of Representatives confirmed Wednesday.

House Speaker Faustino Dy III issued an official statement mourning Cua's death and recognizing his service to Quirino and to local governments nationwide. ABS-CBN News, GMA News and the Philippine Daily Inquirer independently reported his passing.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Cua was serving as governor of Quirino and as president of the Union of Local Authorities of the Philippines. He had also served as Quirino vice governor and as representative of the province's lone congressional district.
Independent reporting says Cua died Tuesday evening, September 15. The House's September 16 statement confirms his passing.

sections.heading: What remains unresolved
paragraphs: The cause and circumstances of Cua's death have not been publicly disclosed by his family or the provincial government as of this publication. FMB News is therefore not attributing a cause of death or repeating unsupported speculation.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Cua held both provincial and national local-government leadership roles. His death creates a leadership transition in Quirino and removes a sitting national representative of local-government interests through ULAP.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for an official announcement from Cua's family or the Quirino provincial government regarding funeral arrangements and any further information they choose to disclose, as well as formal implementation of the province's succession process.

verificationNotes: The House of Representatives published an official statement from Speaker Faustino Dy III confirming Cua's death at 12:56:50 p.m. PHT on September 16.
ABS-CBN News, GMA News and the Philippine Daily Inquirer independently reported Cua's death.
GMA's report was updated at 4:45 p.m. PHT, after its initial 12:53 p.m. publication.
The cause and circumstances of death are not stated as fact because they have not been publicly disclosed by Cua's family or the Quirino provincial government in the verified sources reviewed.

The hero image is the 2019 official portrait of Cua from the League of Provinces of the Philippines, hosted by Wikimedia Commons and marked PD-PhilippinesGov. Commons identifies the League of Provinces of the Philippines as author and the work as public domain in the Philippines.
